_comment: Single source of truth for the project -> repos mapping. Maintained by hand: to add a new project, ask the skill directly (see README.md / SKILL.md Step 1) instead of editing this by hand, unless you prefer to do it yourself.

projects.name: Example Project
projects.notes: Multi-repo, different orgs (example-org vs example-partner-org) — don't assume a single org when adding credentials. Deployment Frequency: independent count per repo (frontend and backend deploy decoupled, no simultaneous tag in both required).

projects.name: Example Merge Project
projects.notes: Branches that auto-deploy on every merge and publish neither releases nor tags: deploy_source "merge" counts each merged PR as a deploy (integration/CD cadence, not production releases). The backend lives on Azure DevOps (organization/project/repository, PAT via AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT).
